linework.observation: Clean dark contours define protagonist, pump casing, valves, pipe runs and log table.

colour.observation: Muted gray, navy, cream and dusty blue with small red valve accents.

shading.observation: Soft cel shadows and simplified metal bands fit the reference style.

character_construction.observation: The protagonist has a recognizable bald head, full face and coherent limbs.

backgrounds.observation: Dense machinery space with pipework, pumps and sealed doors; no outside view.

finish.observation: Polished, legible 2D illustration without obvious artifacts.

identity.observation: Bald protagonist and navy coveralls remain consistent with the scene’s level.

content.observation: Handset and equipment log fit a watch call in the machinery space.

composition.observation: Wide full-body framing gives the character headroom and shows the equipment around him.

regions.people_faces: One bald protagonist holding the sound-powered handset.
regions.foreground_props: Phone cord, console, log table and red pencil.
regions.architecture: Pipes, gauges, large pump and watertight door.
regions.distance: Dense equipment rows recede without obscuring the protagonist.
regions.lighting: Cream overhead lights with cool steel and muted blue equipment.
